question: Which of the following causes of malabsorption occurs with alteration of the intestinal mucosa ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Celiac disease -> alteration of intestinal mucosa -> malabsorption -> 95% CHAIN: A cholestasis -> alteration of intestinal mucosa -> malabsorption -> 95%
analysis: Celiac disease is a condition that causes malabsorption due to alterations in the intestinal mucosa, specifically damage to the lining of the small intestine in response to gluten consumption.
